context: Reference review: method reference receiver binding versus a behavior-preserving reference.

checklist.name: Creates review.md with a decision
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear accept/reject recommendation for the proposal.

checklist.name: Explains the observable difference
checklist.description: States that after reload the original still reads the replacement source while the proposal keeps returning ratings from the initial source.

checklist.name: Rejects source::snapshot
checklist.description: Identifies that source::snapshot binds the receiver when the supplier is created in the constructor, so later reassignment of source is ignored, and rejects that part of the change.

checklist.name: Accepts Pairing::white
checklist.description: States that replacing p -> p.white() with Pairing::white preserves behavior and is fine to keep.

checklist.name: Gives a safe direction
checklist.description: Recommends keeping the lambda () -> source.snapshot() (or an equivalent that reads the field on each call) for the supplier.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: Does not propose unrelated redesign such as making source final, adding synchronization, or changing the public API, and does not mention internal workflow labels.
